call.text: Recurrent models factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences, generating each hidden state h_t as a function of the previous hidden state h_t‑1 and the input at position t, which inherently makes the computation sequential and precludes parallelization within training examples [AIAYN:1:c002]. This sequential nature becomes critical at longer sequence lengths because memory constraints limit batching across examples, making the lack of parallelization more impactful for long sequences [AIAYN:1:c002].
